about: CleanTech Vanadium Mining Corp., an exploration-stage mining company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in the United States and Bolivia. It explores for nickel, gold, zinc, lead, silver, and vanadium deposits. The company holds 100% interest in the Gibellini vanadium project located in Nevada, the United States. It also holds interest in the Kentucky Illinois Fluorspar project located in Kentucky and Illinois, the United States; and the Triunfo project located in the Bolivia. It also holds 100% interest in the Hardin County Properties, a 1,700-acre package of highly prospective mineral rights in the historic Cave-in-Rock and Rosiclare fluorspar mining district and near the Hicks Dome rare-earth fluorspar deposit in Hardin County, Illinois. The company was formerly known as Flying Nickel Mining Corp. and changed its name to CleanTech Vanadium Mining Corp. in October 2024. CleanTech Vanadium Mining Corp. was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
